text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
… "Schoolhouse-inspired chocolate sweets"… 
…What could I be missing—

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text: Dad…? —Hallo?

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Schatz. …I heard about the contest from the 
sales rep at Yuushun Confectionery. How are you doing?"

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
"…Ah. All is well. I believe we will set down a great 
result and liven up the contest."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"…I see. —Flash. You know of Schwarzwälder 
Kirschtorte, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
"? Yes. It's a well known specialty with the Black 
Forest in the Schwarzwäld region as motif, made 
with distilled cherry liquor, right?"

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Right. There are many theories, but it is said that the cream 
represents the snow in the forest, the chocolate chips represent 
the fallen leaves, and the cherries represent the industry."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"I don't live near Schwarzwäld, but I can feel 
the Black Forest when I eat its Kirschtorte."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"The cold snow, the dense forest, the cherries. It lifts my heart 
to think that these things have been there for so long, that 
they have been loved."

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text: "… Dad…"

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"… Академия Тайсен doesn't have hundreds of years of history or 
specialties yet. So it may be difficult to create something with 
the depth of this Kirschtorte."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text:
"But, it is such a wonderful school with wonderful students like 
you. It must have something that lifts your heart the same way."

text_block_list.name: Flash' Father
text_block_list.text: "If I were you, I would try to find something like that."

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
—In summary, our motif should not be as simple as "races" or 
"the grounds", but something that lifts our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
So here's a question for you all. What lifts your heart here… 
what do you think the appeal of Академия Тайсен is?

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
…! This is a little unexpected. I didn't realize 
there was so much diversity… Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
We should stick with a single element for the motif. 
If there are too many, we will have to choose one, 
or find a common point to combine them.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to ask for details in individual interviews, and narrow 
our motif down from there… What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
—I have a suggestion. There is a more efficient 
method than individual interviews.

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text: Good mooorning!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O. From 7:50 she stands at the gates and greets 
arriving students for 30 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is my daily morning routine! 
Greetings are the basis of everything! It's a 
natural part of being a model student!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text:
It's lunchtime! Everyone! I'll collect your 
Japanese homework! Come, come, give them to me, please!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. Thanks as always. You're a great help, Baku-chan.

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha-ha! Yes, yes, you can count on me!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text:
A strong greeting, Bakushinshin! The class's 
reliable Bakushinshin! Study hard, Bakushinshin! 
Run ahead, Bakushinshiiin!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text:
Well, that wraps up my evening Bakushin exercises! 
See you tomorrow, have a good niiight!

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
—A picture is worth a thousand words. I see. She 
really lives an exemplary life, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
I was able to understand how Bakushin O feels about her 
school life… much more clearly than with an interview.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
A deeper understanding will be useful to reconsider the motif 
on. I suggest we continue this method to pseudo-experience 
everyone's lifestyles.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: …Faah, I'm so drowsy—

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm? Huh, what's up with you two? Oh, right. 
We were doing that thing today huh?

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Monch, monch… Yummyー The weather's great, 
isn't today just the best? …Aaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Shut it. Wassup?

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: I forgot we had a 5th period assignment! Aw crap!

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hang on, this is too cute!? I want it… 
ah, wait I'm broke.

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Hey Jordan, isn't your middle finger broken? The nail, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Aw, for real! My nails are key to 
victory. …Where are the care products?

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
She has a strong interest in cosmetics, especially when it 
concerns her nails. The size of her friend group left an 
impression as well, didn't it? …Interesting

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's my turn last… I'll do 
my best! Um, I'm pleased to work with you…!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Flower! And excuse me! But I didn't understand 
yesterday's homework, and I was wondering if you could help me—

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! Of course! If I will do!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
I always bring my self-made lunch box. When the weather 
is nice, I often go eat in the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
And… actually I made lunch for the two of you as well today. So 
if you don't mind, why don't we eat together?

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm renting a small field and planting strawberries 
this year. I thought we'd eat them together in the spring.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
After a quick check, I'm off to training. …Something 
like that? Has this really been helpful?

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Of course. …Hehe. The leaves are healthy and look great. 
Are you taking care of this one by yourself too?

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Basically, yes. But preparing for winter and such is a little 
tough. I wish I could do it by myself, but…
